reviews.review_description: This is such a good game, i have played every level. Despite it being early access its good. Only sometimes u cant complete a level while having done everything, sometimes u cant reach the spots that are left to clean. But other than that i love it

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for the kind review! 😊 I’m already working on fixing the issues you mentioned, and the improvements should be included in the next update. Hopefully, your next cleaning session will be even better! Thanks for playing and supporting the game! ❤️
